results.name: The New Young Adult Community
results.description: A young adult community based at a Seventh-day Adventist church in Candler. Members gather for monthly vespers and Bible discussion, game and social nights, and group hikes.
results.notes: Meetup events from the Candler SDA church; no independent site found.

results.name: AHyder Productions
results.description: A film production company that hosted a single ticketed mental health film festival.
results.notes: One ticketed film festival event; a production company, not a membership group.

results.name: Asheville 20s-40s Social Group
results.description: A social group for Asheville adults in their 20s through 40s. Regular outings include board game nights at breweries, swing dance nights, disc golf and local festivals.
results.notes: 73 Meetup events with 7 upcoming; clear recurring membership group.

results.name: Asheville Baddies Unite
results.description: A women's social group that meets for brunches, gallery walks, movie nights and money talks, with an emphasis on supporting and uplifting one another.
results.schedule: A couple of times a month
results.notes: 14 Meetup events May-Sep 2026; last event Sep 5.

results.name: Asheville Center for Inner Healing Sangha
results.description: A small meditation sangha in Weaverville offering guided and silent sits with optional sharing before and after. Directions are given on RSVP.
results.notes: Hosted by a healing practice but events are a sangha sit; no events since March 2026.

results.name: Asheville English Country Dance
results.description: A free weekly English country dance with rotating callers and recorded music. No partner or experience needed.
results.notes: 9 weekly events Jun-Aug 2026; distinct from Old Farmer's Ball per the earlier note.

results.name: Asheville In-town Walking Group
results.description: A walking group that explores Asheville neighborhoods on moderate group walks of a few miles, starting from parks and local landmarks.
results.notes: Meetup page; 16 events with 4 upcoming. Web search found no separate site.

results.name: Asheville Movement Collective
results.description: A community ecstatic dance group that hosts freeform dance waves with guest DJs, live musicians and facilitators. Each session has an opening circle and a theme.
results.notes: Search results show AMC hosting Ecstatic Dance Waves at Evergreen; site named in AMC guidelines.

results.name: Asheville Samba do Roda
results.description: A community circle where players trade hand percussion and vocals in the Brazilian samba de roda tradition while dancers jump in and out.
results.notes: 9 monthly events at Archetype; listed on Mountain Xpress. Organizer is the venue; no site found.

results.name: Asheville Swing Night
results.description: A monthly swing dance with a beginner lesson followed by social dancing to a DJ. Lindy Hop, East Coast Swing, Charleston and Balboa; no partner needed.
results.notes: Confirmed via Explore Asheville listing. Likely the same community as c:swing-asheville, not verified.

results.name: Asheville's Fantasy/Sci-Fi Books and Beer Club
results.description: A book club for fantasy and science fiction readers that meets at a neighborhood pub to discuss a monthly pick. Drop-ins who have not finished the book are welcome.
results.notes: 12 monthly Meetup events with reading list; clear book club.

results.name: Awakening Asheville
results.description: A Meetup account that lists a wide range of paid classes, healing sessions and trainings run by many different hosts.
results.notes: 670 events from many hosts (Energetic Experiences, online trainings); a promoter/aggregator, not one group.

results.name: Blue Ridge Audubon
results.description: The local chapter of the National Audubon Society serving Buncombe and Henderson counties. Members hold free program meetings, bird outings and sanctuary workdays.
results.notes: Known website; real volunteer chapter. Listed events were museum walks led by its guide.

results.name: Carolinas' Nature Photographers Association, Asheville
results.description: The Asheville division of a nonprofit nature photography club. It offers monthly meetings with speakers and critiques, plus photo outings.
results.notes: cnpa.org Asheville page; dues-based club with about 175 members.

results.name: Community Waltz
results.description: A monthly social waltz where dancers and musicians of all levels gather. Informal instruction is offered for newcomers.
results.notes: 5 monthly events at the JCC; no independent site found.

results.name: Dementia Partners AVL Support Group
results.description: A free support group for people living with dementia and the family members who care for them. It meets at YMCA of WNC branches.
results.home_base: YMCA of WNC branches, Asheville area
results.notes: YMCA of WNC listings confirm the group; meeting days vary by branch.

results.name: Emotions for Entrepreneurs and Executives
results.description: A single listed relaxation session aimed at entrepreneurs and executives.
results.notes: One 'Weekly Unwind' event; reads as a practitioner offering aimed at professionals.

results.name: FOMO Collective
results.description: An Asheville collective of DJs and visual artists who pair DJ sets with light and projection art. It hosted free Second Saturday nights.
results.notes: Grey: only 2 listings (Dec 2025, Jan 2026), no independent web presence. Kept per grey rule; could drop.

results.name: Hablamos Espanol Conversation Group
results.description: A free weekly Spanish conversation group led by a native speaker for high-intermediate and advanced learners. It is a conversation, not a class.
results.home_base: AmeriHealth Caritas NC Wellness Center, Asheville
results.notes: 14 weekly Eventbrite events through Aug 2026; hosted by a health plan's wellness center, no site found.

results.name: Homeschooler's Hangout
results.description: A weekly drop-in game meetup for homeschooling families at a board game cafe, with games for a range of ages.
results.home_base: Well Played Board Game Cafe, Asheville
results.notes: 25 weekly events Dec 2025-Jun 2026, none since.

results.name: Irish Session at Diatribe Brewing
results.description: A weekly traditional Irish music session where local fiddlers, whistle players and others play tunes together. Listeners and new players are welcome.
results.notes: 39 weekly events with 6 upcoming; players are regulars though the venue lists it.

results.name: Kick & Sip
results.description: A casual footbag and hacky sack group that meets at Asheville breweries to kick around and socialize. Drop-ins are welcome.
results.notes: 3 Meetup events Jul-Sep 2026.

results.name: Liberty Bicycles Urban Cruise Ride
results.description: A weekly social group ride for all abilities along Asheville greenways and bike paths, followed by drinks at New Belgium.
results.notes: 46 events and 8 upcoming; standing ride with regulars, so shop_hosted_ride rule says keep.

results.name: Meditation in Asheville
results.description: Meditation and Modern Buddhism classes at the Je Tsongkhapa Kadampa Buddhist Center, with talks, retreats and guided meditation.
results.home_base: Je Tsongkhapa Kadampa Buddhist Center, Asheville
results.notes: 72 events at one Kadampa center; a center's programming but also a sangha community. Grey, kept.

results.name: Mindful Roots Asheville
results.description: A wellness community offering men's councils, gentle yoga with meditation, and movement sessions around Asheville.
results.home_base: Asheville Community Yoga and WellSpring, Asheville
results.notes: 70 events incl. Rooted Brotherhood Men's Council; some classes may be instructor-led. Grey, kept.

results.name: Next Season Collective: Between Seasons
results.description: A social collective for slower, low-pressure gatherings such as seasonal picnics at the Botanical Gardens.
results.notes: Only one event (Jun 2026). Grey, kept; could drop.

results.name: Open Electric Jam at 185 King Street
results.description: A weekly Sunday open jam where the house band opens and visiting musicians plug in and sit in. Listeners welcome; free entry.
results.notes: Venue is in Brevard (in area), not Harrah's; that organizer entry is a data error. Venue-hosted jam; kept as musicians' regular jam.

results.name: PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis
results.description: A company's tennis matching service with paid practice sessions and challenge leagues.
results.notes: Meetup is a promotion for the PlayYourCourt company's paid league and sessions.

results.name: Reiki & Energy Mastery Collective
results.description: A practitioner-led account that listed one free Reiki share in a park.
results.notes: One event; hosted by a Reiki practitioner promoting her services.

results.name: Senseful Soul's Asheville Healing Community
results.description: A practitioner's calendar of paid yoga, sound healing, astrology and ritual sessions.
results.notes: 61 events of workshops and classes hosted by one practitioner brand; no clear member community.

results.name: Slonuts AVL
results.description: A no-drop Monday morning social bike ride that starts with coffee and ends at Hole Doughnuts. Rides run 10-14 miles with rotating ride leaders.
results.notes: 116 weekly events; Instagram handle @slonuts.avl from event description (not confirmed by search).

results.name: Stitch N Listen
results.description: A low-key community crafting circle where members work on projects while listening to an audio short story.
results.notes: 3 monthly library events Jul-Sep 2026.

results.name: Tarot Club
results.description: A monthly meetup for studying tarot and personal reflection, with a different method or guest teacher each month.
results.notes: 10 events at The Well with guest leaders; recurring study circle.

results.name: The Social Sangha

results.home_base: The Lodge at Quietude, Black Mountain
results.notes: 11 Sunday meditations Dec 2025-Mar 2026; none since.

results.name: Unity Game Developers WNC

results.notes: Meetup group; one event seen in data but describes returning community members.

results.home_base: The Well and Haw Creek Commons, Asheville
results.notes: 3 Meetup events Aug-Sep 2026; recurring integration circle.

results.name: Winter Women
results.description: A monthly gathering for mature women to study Celtic spirituality and discuss sisterhood, hosted by a church-based ministry.
results.notes: 4 meetings Dec 2025-Mar 2026, a winter series; none since.

results.name: Women & Wellness
results.description: A women's circle exploring wellness and the divine feminine through conversation and shared reflection.
